title: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth: card flavor text
storyline: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

entities.name: Gríma Wormtongue
entities.description: A counselor who spat before the king's feet and urged him to let others deal with irksome guests.

entities.name: Aragorn
entities.description: A ranger called Strider, the greatest traveler and huntsman of the age, who became King Elessar and wedded Arwen.

entities.name: Faramir
entities.description: Captain of Gondor who hopes to see the White Tree flower again and Minas Tirith in peace.

entities.name: Gondor

entities.name: Rohirrim

entities.name: White Tree

entities.name: Barrow-downs

entities.description: Frodo's father.

entities.name: The Shire

events.summary: Wormtongue spits before the king's feet.
events.quote: Wormtongue bared his teeth; and then with a hissing breath he spat before the king's feet.

events.summary: Isildur cuts the Ring from Sauron's hand, overthrowing him.
events.quote: Isildur cut the Ring from Sauron's hand with the hilt-shard of his father's sword, and Sauron himself was overthrown.

events.summary: Bilbo vanishes from Hobbiton using the Ring after his speech.
events.quote: he was never seen by any Hobbit in Hobbiton again.

events.summary: Gandalf is imprisoned on the pinnacle of Orthanc.
events.quote: They took me and set me on the pinnacle of Orthanc.

events.summary: Gwaihir bears Gandalf from Orthanc.
events.quote: "How far can you bear me?" asked Gandalf.

events.summary: Frodo is stabbed by a Morgul-knife.
events.quote: Frodo felt a pain like a dart of poisoned ice pierce his left shoulder.

events.summary: The Nazgûl's horses are swept into the flood.
events.quote: leaping forward in terror they bore their riders into the rushing flood.

events.summary: Frodo volunteers to take the Ring to Mordor.
events.quote: I will take the Ring to Mordor, though I do not know the way.

events.summary: Gandalf stands firm against the Balrog.
events.quote: But Gandalf stood firm.

events.summary: The Balrog drags Gandalf into the abyss.
events.quote: "Fly, you fools!" he cried, and was gone.

events.summary: Galadriel passes the test and refuses the Ring.
events.quote: I pass the test. I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.

events.summary: Boromir dies after trying to take the Ring.
events.quote: I tried to take the Ring from Frodo. I am sorry. I have paid.

events.summary: Gandalf breaks Saruman's staff.
events.quote: the staff split asunder in Saruman's hand

events.summary: Erkenbrand charges against the hosts of Isengard.
events.quote: Down from the hills leaped Erkenbrand, lord of Westfold, and the hosts of Isengard roared in fear.

events.summary: Gimli and Legolas compete in counting kills.
events.quote: Now my count passes Master Legolas.

events.summary: Pippin swears fealty to Gondor.
events.quote: Here do I swear fealty to Gondor, until my lord release me, or death take me.

events.summary: Shelob stings Frodo.
events.quote: Shelob with hideous speed came behind and stung him in the neck.

events.summary: The Witch-king rides through the gate.
events.quote: In rode the Lord of the Nazgûl, under the archway that no enemy ever yet had passed

events.summary: Gollum is tormented in Mordor.
events.quote: In Mordor, all that he knew was forced from him.

events.summary: Frodo puts on the Ring and Sauron becomes aware of his folly.
events.quote: As Frodo put on the Ring, Sauron was suddenly aware of the magnitude of his own folly.

events.summary: The Captains of the West challenge the Black Gate.
events.quote: The Captains of the West came at last to challenge the Black Gate and the might of Mordor.

events.summary: Gwaihir sees two figures fall and swoops down to save them.
events.quote: Gwaihir saw the two figures fall, worn out, hiding their eyes from death.

events.summary: Frodo forgives Gollum after the Ring is destroyed.
events.quote: But for Gollum, I could not have destroyed the Ring. So let us forgive him!

events.summary: Aragorn weds Arwen.
events.quote: Aragorn the King Elessar wedded Arwen Undómiel

events.summary: Aragorn plants the new White Tree.
events.quote: Aragorn planted the new tree in the court by the fountain

events.summary: Galadriel throws down Dol Guldur.
events.quote: Galadriel threw down its walls and laid bare its pits, and the forest was cleansed.

events.summary: The Tooks march in led by Pippin to fight the ruffians.
events.quote: The Tooks marched in with Pippin at their head.

events.summary: Saruman meets a nasty end.
events.quote: A nasty end for Saruman

events.summary: Samwise gives the Red Book to his daughter before sailing West.
events.quote: Her father Samwise gave her the Red Book for safekeeping before he sailed into the West.
